strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Damn, I never thought the enemy forces would be spread this far...!
So you've come... Londo Bell, is it!
You've done well against us of the Vega Star Federation...
...but this is where you'll be buried!
These guys... the Vega Star Federation...!
Big talk! Don't get full of yourself!
Vianno, don't take the bait... hm!?
Brother, that mark on the battleship...!
The cross-star...! This is bad! Captain, I'm launching now!
Umon!? It's dangerous to rush ahead! All hands, battle stations!
Whoever can launch, sortie!
Duuuke Fleeeed! Dizer, go!!
Umon, what's wrong?
That cross-star... is the mark of King Vega's Royal Guard...!
If they're showing up... it means the Vega Star Federation
...is finally getting serious about invading Earth...!
The guardian deity of Planet Fleed... Grendizer!
As you guessed, I am Gorman, a Royal Guard captain serving King Vega.
Prepare yourself, Duke Fleed!
Talking tough, huh? Sure is confident.
King Vega...!
The crime of destroying the green planet Fleed... I haven't forgotten...!
You're the ones who should prepare yourselves, King Vega included...!
Quiet, Duke Fleed! All units, commence attack!
Take out the enemies one by one! Commence attack!
Hm, enemy contacts!? A new force!?
Lookit 'em all. I see, so that there's the Vega Star Federation.
Then this lot must be...
What! A new Earthling weapon!?
Captain, what's their ID signal!?
...Unknown.
But it's neither Zeon nor Vega... it's a completely new force!
Get in our way and ya'll pay! Not that we won't trash ya anyway!
Oh, no...
They're... attacking!?
It's a pain, but don't lay a finger on them Vega whatsits!
Trash the Earthlings!
They're hostile! ...A new force, here of all places...!
Fine, then I'll take every last one of you on!
Come on, bring it!
Damn, but there are so many...!
Captain, if worst comes to worst... we withdraw.
...Is there no other choice...
They don't seem to be attacking us. ...Fwahaha! Excellent!
Brother! What are those guys!?
Who are you! Why are you siding with the Vega Star Federation!
Sidin'? What're ya talkin' about? Sidin', schmidin'!
We're after Earth's treasure! Get in our way and ya know what happens!
Treasure...!?
You mean, like, gold coins and stuff?
Earth's beautiful green land is its true treasure!
Just like the Vega Star Federation, I won't let you trample it...!
Green? Quit spoutin' that naive crap, ya moron!
We'll burn it all down, then take our sweet time huntin' treasure!
Kenrouuu!
A robot...!? Where did it come from!?
Oh my, isn't he striking a pose!
Y-you're... R-Rom Stol! Don't tell me ya followed us here!?
Whoops, don't forget us.
All right! That's how it is!
Making trouble even on a backwater planet like this. You're the worst!
M-Miss, please don't push yourself too hard.
That's right, Leina. The Power Riser can't handle this.
Gettin' in our way again! Argh, trash 'em all!
You don't seem to be enemies... but who are you?
I'll explain in detail later. We are your allies.
You'll simply have to trust us.
Come on, isn't pushing back against these odds what matters right now?
...Understood.
Captain!?
If they were enemies, they'd have crushed our bridge by now, Captain.
Right now we need every unit we can get. Even mysterious ones.
Yup, yup.
Captain Bright, if that hunk were an enemy, we'd be in deep trouble.
Ugh...
You get it! All right! Let's take 'em all on!
Brother...
I feel the same. ...I want to trust them.
Kenrou will never betray... those who believe in justice. I swear it.
Kenrou...?
Jim, you've got the resupply unit equipped, right?
I know minding our wild filly is tough, but back her up.
Understood, Jet.
Who are you calling a wild filly! Honestly!
All right... let's go!
Wh-whoa!?
Gorman! I'm going to cut King Vega's Royal Guard down to size!
Duke Fleed! Don't think you've won!
Barking while you retreat isn't a good look, pal.
You fools... defy the Vega Star Federation and you'll regret it...!
If you mean to keep up this senseless invasion, I'll show no mercy...!
Grrr...! Blast it, retreat!
King Vega's Royal Guard... so they've finally made their move...!
What!? What the heck!? Why're we gettin' beat up like this!
Retreat! Retreat! Ya'll pay for this!
Nyah! Don't come back!
Miss, that's unladylike!
All talk, as usual. What now, Rom?
We can't catch them from here... Besides, I'm worried about these folks.
Rom's just too nice for his own good.
The enemies in this area... are all wiped out.
Phew, that was close. Anyway, they saved us.
Who on earth are these people...
Thank you for helping us. I'll ask again... who are you?
Nobody worth naming... right, Rom?
Yes, it would only confuse you... We couldn't stand by and watch cruelty...
That's all we are.
That's hardly an explanation...
Miss Leina, take a look at this data.
What is it, Jim? Oh... Brother! I've found Devil Saturn's retreat route!
If we follow this...
All right, then we'll find their home base!
...Good, after them! People of another world, good fortune in battle.
(So, just like Umon... they're from another star system.)
Wait. Why did you... help us?
One who loves the green can't be evil... That's why I lent a hand.
We may never meet again... but until then.
Wow, talk about laying it on thick.
To think there were still warriors like that... in this universe...
Koji would love this kind of thing.
Enemies and allies alike, all unknown.
What on earth is happening in the Earth Sphere...
